text:
East Rutherford webatara dị ka obodo na March 28, 1894, nke e kewapụtara na Boiling Springs Township. Obere obodo Bergen County dị ihe dị ka kilomita 7 n'ebe ọdịda anyanwụ nke Midtown Manhattan, ọ na-adabere na Meadowlands Sports Complex — ụlọ nke MetLife Stadium, Meadowlands Racetrack na nnukwu ụlọ ahịa American Dream. Meadowlands Sports Complex mepere na 1976, MetLife Stadium sochiri na 2010. N'agbanyeghị obere nha ya, obodo ahụ nwere ọnọdụ dị ukwuu na akụkọ ihe mere eme egwuregwu: ọ bụ obodo kacha nta nke na-anabata Super Bowl, ebe ọ mere Super Bowl XLVIII na 2014, ma ọ na-anabata 2026 World Cup ikpeazụ.

Ọdịbendị bọọlụ, Otú ọ dị, na-esiteghị na obodo ahụ kama na mpaghara New York/New Jersey buru ibu — otu n'ime ahịa buru ibu ma nwee mmasị na bọọlụ na United States. Mpaghara ahụ bụ ụlọ nke New York Red Bulls na NYCFC, ma na-echeta New York Cosmos nke 1970s na 1980s, ndị nwere Pelé na Beckenbauer n'ọkwa ha. A na-ekpuchikwa ya site na nnukwu ndị fan Latino, European na African diaspora na-enye mpaghara ahụ mmekọrịta miri emi, polyglot na egwuregwu ụwa.

Agụụ ahụ egosila ogologo oge n'ọnụ ụzọ. MetLife Stadium na onye bu ya ụzọ, Giants Stadium, wulitere ndekọ nke ire ere nke nnukwu egwuregwu mba ụwa, site na Copa América Centenario ikpeazụ ruo Argentina–Brazil superclásicos. Nnabata bi-state nke ahịa ahụ ka edere n'ụzọ doro anya n'ime njirimara asọmpi: maka World Cup, a na-akpọ ebe ahụ "New York New Jersey Stadium," nkwenye kpọmkwem na ndị fan na-agbasa n'ofe steeti abụọ karịa obodo nta. Ọ bụ mpaghara ahụ, ọ bụghị East Rutherford naanị, ka a na-ezube ijide njirimara World Cup.
